body: promptoverseEffectiveDelay adds +15s per successful request already made this run (capped +2m) on top of the 20s base, addressing API overload still hitting around the 3rd-4th generation with flat spacing. Cross-invocation backoff extra now applies throughout a run, not just the first request. 3 new tests. Commit 464a97b.
title: Prompt-o-verse: escalating per-run inter-request delay
